verdict.rationale: LlamaParse is a SaaS API platform, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question. The evidence shows only a single API key spanning all products, plus SSO and role-based access controls for managing user access to organizations and projects. That RBAC is an adjacent control and does not document issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
